content.comment_body: Is there a bug in [product_name] V8.0? When I create a new program using [product_name] [version_no], targeting [product_name] [version_no], and then add a text block, the properties for configuring the TD display are not available. If I start a project for a newer [product_name] [version_no] and add a text block, the TD display settings do show up. If I later switch this project back to an older [product_name] [version_no], suddenly the TD display settings become accessible for the text block. Am I missing something or is this an issue with the software?

Hello, What specific settings are you unable to find? For the [product_name] TD (versions 6 and 7), aside from the text message properties, the only relevant options are found in file/text message properties (character set, ticker time). I hope this clarifies things.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have reported inconsistent availability of TD display configuration settings in [product_name] V8 when working with text blocks for various [product_name] [version_no] versions. TD display options are missing when starting a project for one older version but show up when the project is first created for a newer version and then switched back. This inconsistency is causing confusion about how to configure TD display settings in the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to consistently access TD display settings in [product_name] V8 text block properties for all supported [product_name] [version_no], including older versions.
